aco.name: Acute coronary occlusion (ACO)
aco.description: Acute coronary occlusion (complete or incomplete) vs no occlusion on the catheterization that followed the ECG (ACS cohort v6). Fine-tuned DINOv3, top 2 blocks.

acco_vs_aico.name: Complete (ACCO) vs incomplete (AICO) occlusion
acco_vs_aico.description: Probability that an acute coronary occlusion is complete (ACCO) rather than incomplete (AICO). Trained on occlusion ECGs only; interpreted only when the aco output is positive.
